note: The 14 adversarial messages as corpus items. Each demand is 'core' when the core's mechanisms answer it and tests/test_adversarial.py checks it; 'met' when a mechanism beyond the core answers it and tests/test_adversarial.py checks it; 'residue' when it is met with the residue the test recorded, written so that the limit shows; or 'not met' for the one demand no mechanism meets.
